structured_summary: In a quiet office, the robot announces a package delivery via speech. The user must acknowledge the delivery (by speech or head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement. Upon receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must give a final confirmation via speech within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.
